summary: Phase 142 upgrades DORK from lexical word-overlap retrieval (Phase 141) to full semantic cosine similarity search. The CSS engine introduces a two-layer embedder: Ollama nomic-embed-text as the primary path and a pure-Python TF-IDF / hash-space bag-of-words fallback (CSS-PYDROID-0) activated when Ollama is unreachable (CSS-FALLBACK-0). The retriever gains three explicit strategies — semantic (cosine primary), hybrid (0.6·cosine + 0.4·keyword), and keyword (Phase 141 baseline) — exposed via a new strategy= parameter on all public API functions. Session-level embedding dimension is locked after the first successful embed (CSS-DIM-0), enforcing dimensional consistency invariant. All similarity computations use cosine similarity (CSS-COSINE-0). The embed_corpus.py pre-computation script generates corpus_embeddings.json with staleness detection, --dry-run / --force / --fallback flags, and deterministic sorted output (CSS-DETERM-0). Pre-computed embeddings are consumed by the retriever at query time, reducing per-query latency to a single query embedding call.
